works.body:
Absolutely fell in LOVE with your last one, again of course.  i just HAD to come back again, i did see you drew my friend allusunday and thought you did amazing as well! so this time i did want to go ahead and draw another friend of mine, with me again. Aku, aku is a cat girl ninja with white hair, and she's kind of a brat, and then there's me, lulu of course. 

References: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zWOYereS2nZz34-cTsWSoxTMsljvmXBQ?usp=drive_link

i love your creativity and your attention to detail, i want you to do what you desire and what you think would suit us best! Thank you again for every piece you've made for me, and i cant stop coming back. i appreciate your art and work. May we meet again!
